path: StarterPlayerScripts/ShopFx.luau
purpose: Feature: Visual and feel pass (art, juice, readability; no gameplay rules change): In ShopUi.client.luau, scale-tween the panel in on open with a whoosh (GameAssets.play) and increment a shop_opened counter. On a successful buy, play the buy sound, flash the row green, tween a level bar fill, and increment shop_purchases. Buying must use the same server validation as the pads. If the player has too little cash, shake the row and play an error buzz. Use the existing GameAssets and UiTheme. -- Client-only ModuleScript with pure presentation helpers, required by ShopUi.client.luau. It uses GameAssets (play for sounds, palette) and UiTheme for colors, and TweenService. API: ShopFx.openPanel(panel, opts) sets the panel's UIScale (created if missing) to about 0.85 with transparency up, tweens it to 1 with Back easing over about 0.25s, calls GameAssets.play for the whoosh and fires the ShopOpened remote once per open; it cancels any running tween so rapid toggling is safe. ShopFx.closePanel(panel) is an optional quick reverse tween. ShopFx.buySuccess(row, level, maxLevel) plays the buy sound, tweens the row background to a green flash and back, and tweens a level bar fill to level/maxLevel. The bar is a Frame with a UICorner, created under the row if it does not exist and named 'LevelBar'. ShopFx.buyFail(row) plays the error buzz (GameAssets.play with the error or deny sound id, or a verified fallback) and shakes the row with a short sequence of position offsets that returns to the original Position. All helpers are nil-safe and wrapped in pcall so a missing asset cannot break the shop. Rows and panel stay Active and clickable throughout. It sends no purchase data; the purchase request path is unchanged. Bump ForgeTelemetry counters: shop_opened, shop_purchases.
depends: ReplicatedStorage/GameAssets.luau, ReplicatedStorage/UiTheme.luau

--!strict
-- UiTheme: pure shared UI kit for the house Theme (no side effects, no server code).
-- Palette matches the HUD / cash look: yellow Primary, green Good, red Bad, blue Info, dark Ink outlines.
-- Telemetry (shop_opened, shop_purchases) is counted by the server-side owner of those events, not here.

local UiTheme = {}

-- Colors
UiTheme.ink = Color3.fromRGB(28, 22, 38)
UiTheme.cream = Color3.fromRGB(255, 248, 232)
UiTheme.panel = Color3.fromRGB(255, 248, 232)
UiTheme.card = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
UiTheme.text = Color3.fromRGB(28, 22, 38)
UiTheme.accent = Color3.fromRGB(255, 196, 41)
UiTheme.good = Color3.fromRGB(88, 214, 92)
UiTheme.bad = Color3.fromRGB(240, 68, 64)
UiTheme.info = Color3.fromRGB(64, 170, 255)
UiTheme.dim = Color3.fromRGB(190, 184, 176)
UiTheme.locked = Color3.fromRGB(120, 112, 134)

-- Fonts and metrics
UiTheme.font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
UiTheme.headerFont = Enum.Font.LuckiestGuy
UiTheme.cornerRadius = 14
UiTheme.stroke = 3
UiTheme.minButtonHeight = 48 -- at least 44 px touch target
UiTheme.padding = 10

-- Adds a UICorner to a GuiObject (reuses an existing one).
function UiTheme.roundify(guiObject: GuiObject, radius: number?)
	local corner = guiObject:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner")
	if not corner then
		corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
		corner.Parent = guiObject
	end
	(corner :: UICorner).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, radius or UiTheme.cornerRadius)
end

-- Returns a big readable TextButton.
-- props: text, size, position, anchorPoint, color, textColor, parent, name, zIndex, layoutOrder, onClick
function UiTheme.makeButton(props: { [string]: any }): TextButton
	local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
	button.Name = props.name or "Button"
	button.Text = props.text or ""
	local size: UDim2 = props.size or UDim2.fromOffset(160, UiTheme.minButtonHeight)
	if size.Y.Offset < UiTheme.minButtonHeight and size.Y.Scale == 0 then
		size = UDim2.new(size.X.Scale, size.X.Offset, 0, UiTheme.minButtonHeight)
	end
	button.Size = size
	button.Position = props.position or UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
	button.AnchorPoint = props.anchorPoint or Vector2.new(0, 0)
	button.BackgroundColor3 = props.color or UiTheme.accent
	button.TextColor3 = props.textColor or UiTheme.cream
	button.Font = UiTheme.headerFont
	button.TextScaled = true
	button.AutoButtonColor = true
	button.BorderSizePixel = 0
	button.ZIndex = props.zIndex or 1
	button.LayoutOrder = props.layoutOrder or 0

	UiTheme.roundify(button, UiTheme.cornerRadius)

	local border = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	border.Thickness = UiTheme.stroke
	border.Color = UiTheme.ink
	border.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
	border.Parent = button

	local textStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	textStroke.Thickness = UiTheme.stroke
	textStroke.Color = UiTheme.ink
	textStroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Contextual
	textStroke.Parent = button

	local pad = Instance.new("UIPadding")
	pad.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0.16, 0)
	pad.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0.16, 0)
	pad.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 6)
	pad.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 6)
	pad.Parent = button

	local minSize = Instance.new("UISizeConstraint")
	minSize.MinSize = Vector2.new(44, UiTheme.minButtonHeight)
	minSize.Parent = button

	local onClick = props.onClick
	if typeof(onClick) == "function" then
		button.Activated:Connect(function()
			onClick()
		end)
	end

	if props.parent then
		button.Parent = props.parent
	end
	return button
end

return UiTheme

## Lessons from past builds
# Lessons
## Design
- Tune early progression so a playtest of roughly 15 seconds can reach the first purchase or milestone. Use a fast starting income or a cheap first upgrade (a few seconds of income). Slow openings leave the buy loop untested and feel dull. Also keep the second purchase within about 20-30s of idle income, by raising per-item value or lowering the price, so the shop and later upgrades get exercised.
- Give per-event feedback for every economy action: a "+N" popup on collect, plus HUD hints for upgrade cost, affordability or progress. Without it, numbers going up feels weak between purchases.
- Place trigger pads (buy pads, claim gates, etc.) off the spawn path so walking from spawn never fires them accidentally.
- Make moving cubes or other spawned items non-colliding with players (CanCollide = false, or a collision group) and cap their count per area. Otherwise they jitter, stick or knock players around.
- Keep the time to first core-loop activity well inside the playtest window (the probe may last only ~6-15s). Any auto-claim or auto-start fallback should fire within a few seconds (about 3-5s, not 20s), and claim gates should sit near the spawn area, not far outside the plaza. An idle player must still reach the loop quickly. Keep the spec's auto-claim delay and the tested window consistent so the plaza state can still be observed before the claim.
- Budget the whole first-payout path, not just the claim: claim delay + first spawn + conveyor travel (length / speed) should land the first cash-in within about 3-4s of the claim. Use a short, fast conveyor, spawn the first item immediately on claim, and don't leave this borderline.
- Keep tutorial text consistent with the actual flow (e.g. don't say "walk to a gate" if auto-claim happens within seconds). Tutorial steps must be advanced by events that actually occur, or the player is left without guidance. Add a time-based fallback so a step can't stall. Make the steps lead the player to every key feature (buy pad, shop), and check that the guide beam or arrow actually appears (its census count is above 0).
- Feedback should be audible and visible: use verified sound ids from the shared asset table, not weak built-in rbxasset wavs. Add particles or ambient sparkle, and set the bloom threshold low enough that Neon parts glow.
- Shared effect helpers (burst, shake, sound, FOV punch) only matter if gameplay code calls them. Wire each helper to a real event (collect, buy, rebirth, big upgrade) and check that its counter is above 0 after a playtest. Big moments deserve stronger feedback than routine ones: camera shake, a shockwave ring, or a larger popup.

## Luau and Roblox APIs
- The base place is empty: build the map from code (Instance.new Parts, Anchored = true, parented to Workspace).
- Get services with game:GetService("Players") etc.; use task.wait / task.spawn / task.delay, never wait / spawn / delay.
- Players.PlayerAdded can fire before your script connects in a playtest: also loop over Players:GetPlayers() once at startup.
- Wait for characters with player.CharacterAdded (and player.Character if already present); use WaitForChild with a timeout across the client/server boundary.
- ModuleScripts must return exactly one value (usually a table); require them by path, e.g. require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Config")).
- Create RemoteEvents on the server in one place; clients only WaitForChild them and handle nil after the timeout.
- Bump counters for key gameplay events with require(ReplicatedStorage.ForgeTelemetry).count("name", 1) (server only) so playtests can verify the core loop. Include counters for purchases and other branches that need verification.
- Bump an effect counter (sound, burst, popup) where the effect is really created, not where the remote is fired. If the counter is high but the census shows 0 sounds or bursts, the effects are not real or are destroyed before they are counted. Fix the effect, don't trust the counter.
- Count each telemetry counter in exactly one place (the module that owns the event). Duplicate count calls push once-only counters past their expected value; a counter at 2x its expected value (e.g. 12 vs 6, or 2 claims for 1 player) means a double init, double build or duplicate timer, so check for it.
- Do not put telemetry or build side effects at the top level of a ModuleScript that is shared (e.g. a data module in ReplicatedStorage). Module top-level code can run once per environment or require path. Count inside the single builder function that the entry script calls once.
- Each builder/init function must be called exactly once from the entry script. If two modules both build the same thing (e.g. plaza and plot builders both building themes), assign ownership to one.
- Never call warn() or error() for expected situations such as a duplicate-startup guard. Warnings in the output fail "no errors or warnings" checks. Return silently or use print.

```luau
-- ShopFx: client-only presentation helpers for the shop panel and rows.
-- No gameplay rules here. Purchase requests and telemetry stay on the server side
-- (the server counts shop_opened from the ShopOpened remote and shop_purchases from buys).

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local GameAssets = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("GameAssets", 10))
local UiTheme = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("UiTheme", 10))

local ShopFx = {}

local OPEN_SCALE = 0.85
local panelTweens: { [Instance]: { Tween } } = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }) :: any
local rowTweens: { [Instance]: { Tween } } = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }) :: any
local shakeToken: { [Instance]: number } = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }) :: any
local shakeOrigin: { [Instance]: UDim2 } = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }) :: any

local openedRemote: RemoteEvent? = nil
local remoteLookupRunning = false

local function cancelTweens(store: { [Instance]: { Tween } }, key: Instance)
	local list = store[key]
	if list then
		for _, tw in ipairs(list) do
			pcall(function()
				tw:Cancel()
			end)
		end
	end
	store[key] = {}
end

local function track(store: { [Instance]: { Tween } }, key: Instance, tw: Tween)
	local list = store[key]
	if not list then
		list = {}
		store[key] = list
	end
	table.insert(list, tw)
	tw:Play()
end

-- Tries each candidate sound name that exists in GameAssets.Sounds.
local function playAny(names: { string })
	pcall(function()
		local sounds = (GameAssets :: any).Sounds
		for _, name in ipairs(names) do
			if type(sounds) ~= "table" or sounds[name] ~= nil then
				GameAssets.play(name)
				return
			end
		end
	end)
end

local function fireOpened()
	if openedRemote then
		pcall(function()
			(openedRemote :: RemoteEvent):FireServer()
		end)
		return
	end
	if remoteLookupRunning then
		return
	end
	remoteLookupRunning = true
	task.spawn(function()
		local ok = pcall(function()
			local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes", 10)
			local r = remotes and remotes:WaitForChild("ShopOpened", 5)
			if r and r:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
				openedRemote = r
				r:FireServer()
			end
		end)
		remoteLookupRunning = false
		if not ok then
			openedRemote = nil
		end
	end)
end

local function getScale(panel: GuiObject): UIScale
	local s = panel:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale")
	if not s then
		s = Instance.new("UIScale")
		s.Parent = panel
	end
	return s :: UIScale
end

function ShopFx.openPanel(panel: GuiObject?, opts: any?)
	if not panel then
		return
	end
	pcall(function()
		cancelTweens(panelTweens, panel)
		local base = panel:GetAttribute("FxBgT")
		if type(base) ~= "number" then
			base = panel.BackgroundTransparency
			panel:SetAttribute("FxBgT", base)
		end
		local scale = getScale(panel)
		scale.Scale = OPEN_SCALE
		panel.BackgroundTransparency = math.min(1, (base :: number) + 0.5)
		panel.Visible = true
		panel.Active = true
		local info = TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
		track(panelTweens, panel, TweenService:Create(scale, info, { Scale = 1 }))
		track(panelTweens, panel, TweenService:Create(panel, TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), {
			BackgroundTransparency = base :: number,
		}))
	end)
	playAny({ "whoosh", "open", "swoosh", "click" })
	fireOpened()
end

function ShopFx.closePanel(panel: GuiObject?, onDone: (() -> ())?)
	if not panel then
		return
	end
	local ok = pcall(function()
		cancelTweens(panelTweens, panel)
		local scale = getScale(panel)
		local tw = TweenService:Create(scale, TweenInfo.new(0.15, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {
			Scale = OPEN_SCALE,
		})
		tw.Completed:Connect(function()
			if onDone then
				pcall(onDone)
			end
		end)
		track(panelTweens, panel, tw)
	end)
	if not ok and onDone then
		pcall(onDone)
	end
end

local function flashRow(row: GuiObject, color: Color3)
	cancelTweens(rowTweens, row)
	local base = row:GetAttribute("FxBaseColor")
	if typeof(base) ~= "Color3" then
		base = row.BackgroundColor3
		row:SetAttribute("FxBaseColor", base)
	end
	row.BackgroundColor3 = base :: Color3
	local up = TweenService:Create(row, TweenInfo.new(0.1, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), { BackgroundColor3 = color })
	local down = TweenService:Create(row, TweenInfo.new(0.4, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), {
		BackgroundColor3 = base :: Color3,
	})
	up.Completed:Connect(function(state)
		if state == Enum.PlaybackState.Completed then
			track(rowTweens, row, down)
		end
	end)
	track(rowTweens, row, up)
end

local function getBar(row: GuiObject): Frame
	local bar = row:FindFirstChild("LevelBar")
	if bar and bar:IsA("Frame") then
		return bar
	end
	local f = Instance.new("Frame")
	f.Name = "LevelBar"
	f.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1)
	f.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)
	f.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 6)
	f.BackgroundColor3 = UiTheme.good
	f.BorderSizePixel = 0
	f.ZIndex = row.ZIndex + 2
	local c = Instance.new("UICorner")
	c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 3)
	c.Parent = f
	f.Parent = row
	return f
end

function ShopFx.buySuccess(row: GuiObject?, level: number?, maxLevel: number?)
	if not row then
		return
	end
	playAny({ "buy", "purchase", "cash", "coin", "collect" })
	pcall(function()
		flashRow(row, UiTheme.good)
	end)
	pcall(function()
		local maxL = math.max(1, tonumber(maxLevel) or 1)
		local frac = math.clamp((tonumber(level) or 0) / maxL, 0, 1)
		local bar = getBar(row)
		TweenService:Create(bar, TweenInfo.new(0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
			Size = UDim2.new(frac, 0, 0, 6),
		}):Play()
	end)
end

function ShopFx.buyFail(row: GuiObject?)
	if not row then
		return
	end
	playAny({ "error", "deny", "denied", "buzz", "fail" })
	pcall(function()
		flashRow(row, UiTheme.bad)
	end)
	pcall(function()
		local origin = shakeOrigin[row]
		if not origin then
			origin = row.Position
			shakeOrigin[row] = origin
		end
		local token = (shakeToken[row] or 0) + 1
		shakeToken[row] = token
		row.Position = origin
		task.spawn(function()
			local offsets = { 8, -8, 6, -6, 3, -3 }
			for _, dx in ipairs(offsets) do
				if shakeToken[row] ~= token then
					return
				end
				local o = shakeOrigin[row]
				pcall(function()
					row.Position = UDim2.new(o.X.Scale, o.X.Offset + dx, o.Y.Scale, o.Y.Offset)
				end)
				task.wait(0.04)
			end
			if shakeToken[row] == token then
				pcall(function()
					row.Position = shakeOrigin[row]
				end)
			end
		end)
	end)
end

return ShopFx
```
